entities.summary: Yaroslav Ivanovych Zheleznyak is a Ukrainian economist and politician. From 2017 to 2019, he was an adviser to Prime Minister Volodymyr Groysman. In the 2019 Ukrainian parliamentary election he was elected as a People's Deputy of Ukraine of the 9th convocation from the Holos party.
